C0638.title: Procurement Splitting to Circumvent Public Bidding
keywords: breaking up the whole into parts
C0638.summary: A provincial audit of Entity B's annual budget execution found that it split an annual budget of 2.8 million yuan for office consumables procurement into multiple self-procurement batches, keeping each transaction below the public bidding threshold. The cumulative actual procurement reached 2.76 million yuan, and purchase prices were higher than comparable products on the government procurement e-commerce platform. This was identified as circumventing public bidding by breaking up the whole into parts. The audit office ordered immediate rectification, and the finance department demanded deadline correction, issued a warning, and penalized the responsible personnel.
